title: chore: introduce VDOM highlighting components
body:
## Summary

This PR introduces VDOM highlighting components in InstantSearch.js ([FX-1512](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-1512)).

They will be exposed via the Template API later on.

## Review

These new components depend on a common implementation from [`ui-components/highlight-vdom`](https://github.com/algolia/ui-components/tree/master/packages/highlight-vdom) and are wrapped  internally to add the InstantSearch-specific class names. In the future, we may want to move those in a separate `instantsearch-vdom` package to avoid repeating the same code in every VDOM-based InstantSearch flavor.

The final components (with the logic to parse hits and pass parts to the UI component) which will later be exposed in templates live in `src/helpers/components/`, near their existing string-based counterparts.

For now, this addition shouldn't impact the library, and doesn't require a release. It can be merged without waiting for other PRs.
